newsitem.title: USA: Denbury has well blowout in Louisiana.
newsitem.headline: Denbury has well blowout in Louisiana.

text.p: Denbury Resources Inc said Tuesday its SL 411-19 well at Lake Chicot Field in the inland waters of St. Martin Parish, La., had a blowout and is currently flowing and burning dry gas at an estimated rate of 20 million cubic feet per day.
The blowout occurred late last night during well completion operations being conducted by Mallard Bay Drilling, a subsidiary of Parker Drilling Co.
Denbury said initial reports indicate that two workers died and two are unaccounted for.
